The '''''Solidarity''''' was a recent model of [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] and addition to the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] shortly before an [[assault on Kamino]],<ref name="TFU2n" /> [[1 BBY/Legends|approximately twelve months]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="TFU2c">[[The Force Unleashed II (comic)|''The Force Unleashed II'' comic]]</ref> A [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] commanded by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]] [[Yat-De Viedas]] of the [[Corellian Resistance/Legends|Corellian Resistance]], who was so impressed with it he told the Alliance leadership that he would not hear a word against it. It was the location of a meeting between [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] and Captain [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]] following the failed [[Raid on Cato Neimoidia|skirmish]] at [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. The ship later was present at an Alliance rendezvous near the [[Itani Nebula/Legends|Itani Nebula]], where Commodore Viedas reported an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Battle near the Itani Nebula|ambush]], and later accompanied the rest of the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in a strike at the [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] hub [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] which led to the capture of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="TFU2n" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Solidarity'' first appeared in the [[2010]] [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' by [[Sean Williams]].<ref name="TFU2n" />
